summary: The PR introduces new build artifacts and CSS files that were not part of the original issue or fix. These additions are unrelated to resolving the bug.

issues.description: The PR includes numerous new files such as CSS and HTML build artifacts which are not related to fixing the issue with `autodoc_type_aliases` not working when `autodoc_typehints` is set to 'description'. This constitutes non-minimal changes and scope creep.
